info.title: Map the Mess API
info.description: Backend for the community litter reporting platform

get.description: Serve an uploaded image by filename.
List all reports, optionally filtered by status.

schema.title: Response List Reports Api Reports  Get

post.description: Create a new litter report with an optional image. Use POST /{report_id}/images for additional images.

delete.description: Delete a report. Requires moderator or admin role.

post.description: Upload an image and attach it to an existing report.

patch.description: Mark a report as cleaned. Attaches the user id if authenticated.
Set a report back to pending. Requires moderator or admin role.

delete.description: Delete an image. If it was a resolved image, re-open the report to pending.

get.description: List all users. Requires admin access.

schema.title: Response List Users Api Auth Users Get

get.description: Verify a user's email address using the token from the verification email.

post.description: Resend the verification email. Uses ForgotPassword schema (just an email field).
Exchange a valid refresh token for a new access token + refresh token (rotation).
Revoke a refresh token on logout.
Generate a password reset token for the given email.
Reset a user's password using a valid reset token.

get.description: Return the total number of registered volunteers.
Return the top volunteers ranked by number of reports cleaned within the given period.

parameters.name: months

schema.description: Number of months to look back
schema.title: Months

parameters.description: Number of months to look back

parameters.name: limit

schema.description: Number of top volunteers to return
schema.title: Limit

parameters.description: Number of top volunteers to return

schema.title: Response Leaderboard Api Volunteers Leaderboard Get

get.description: List the current user's favourite reports, optionally filtered by status.

parameters.name: status

schema.description: Filter by report status: pending or cleaned
schema.title: Status

parameters.description: Filter by report status: pending or cleaned

schema.title: Response List Favourites Api Volunteers Favourites Get

post.description: Star a report to add it to the user's planned cleanups.

delete.description: Remove a report from the user's planned cleanups.

post.description: Create a new community. The current user becomes the owner.

get.description:
List communities with optional search and location filters.

Visibility: anon/volunteer see active only. Owner also sees own under_review.
Moderator+ sees all.

parameters.name: radius_km

schema.description: Radius in km for nearby search
schema.title: Radius Km

parameters.description: Radius in km for nearby search

schema.title: Response List Communities Api Communities  Get

get.description: Return the current user's owned and joined (approved) communities.
Get a single community. Posts and events are only visible to members, owner, or moderator+.

put.description: Upload or replace the community profile image. Owner only.

patch.description: Set community status to active or under_review. Moderator+ only.

post.description: Create a post on a community page. Owner only.

delete.description: Delete a post. Owner or moderator+ only.

post.description: Create a cleanup event. Owner only.

get.description: Get a single event. Follows community visibility rules.

patch.description: Edit an event. Owner only. All fields optional for partial update.

delete.description: Delete an event. Owner or moderator+ only.

post.description: Request to join a community. Status starts as pending until owner approves.

get.description: List memberships. Owner sees all (pending/approved/rejected). Others see only approved.

schema.title: Response List Memberships Api Communities  Community Id  Memberships Get

patch.description: Approve or reject a membership request. Owner only.

delete.description: Leave a community. Owner cannot leave — they must delete the community.
